proof_scope: fixture wiring plus live limits command with exact inotify watch counts, top watcher readback, Jabra SPEAK 510 USB diagnostics, and meeting audio target switch status

claims.proves: the existing skill entrypoint exits with the expected status and the limits command reports exact inotify watch usage plus top watcher JSON
claims.does_not_prove: semantic correctness of every workstation subsystem, live KDE visual responsiveness, or that sudo-only sysctl changes were applied

cases.name: limits-json-reports-exact-inotify-watch-hogs
command: cd /home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills/skills/ops-workstation && OUTPUT=json ./run.sh limits | tee /tmp/ops-workstation-limits-agentic.json && jq -e '.inotify.current_watches >= 0 and (.inotify.top_watchers | type == "array") and (.inotify.top_watchers[0] | has("watches") and has("pid") and has("process") and has("command"))' /tmp/ops-workstation-limits-agentic.json >/dev/null

cases.name: limits-markdown-does-not-use-approximate-inotify-instance-estimate
command: cd /home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills/skills/ops-workstation && ./run.sh limits | tee /tmp/ops-workstation-limits-markdown-agentic.txt && rg -n "\| inotify watchers \|" /tmp/ops-workstation-limits-markdown-agentic.txt | rg " used \([0-9]+%\) " >/dev/null && ! rg -n "\| inotify watchers \|.*~[0-9]+ instances" /tmp/ops-workstation-limits-markdown-agentic.txt

cases.name: jabra-json-reports-usb-flaps-topology-and-pipewire-context
command:
cd /home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills/skills/ops-workstation && set +e; OUTPUT=json ./run.sh jabra --since '3 days ago' | tee /tmp/ops-workstation-jabra-agentic.json; rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; set -e; [[ $rc -le 2 ]] && python3 - <<'PY2'
import json
d=json.load(open('/tmp/ops-workstation-jabra-agentic.json'))
assert d['schema']=='ops_workstation.jabra_diagnostics.v1'
assert 'disconnects' in d['kernel'] and 'urb_no_device' in d['kernel']
assert 'shared_hub_c920' in d['topology']
assert 'streams' in d['pipewire']
assert 'recommendation' in d and d['recommendation']
PY2

cases.name: audio-switch-status-exposes-streamdeck-callable-fallback-targets
command:
cd /home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills/skills/ops-workstation && OUTPUT=json ./run.sh audio-switch status | tee /tmp/ops-workstation-audio-switch-agentic.json && python3 - <<'PY2'
import json
d=json.load(open('/tmp/ops-workstation-audio-switch-agentic.json'))
assert d['schema']=='ops_workstation.audio_switch.v1'
assert d['status']=='OK'
assert {'jabra-usb','jabra-bt','earbuds-bt','wired'} <= set(d['targets'])
assert d['receipt'].endswith('audio-switch-receipt.json')
PY2

capability_claims.description: limits JSON exposes exact current_watches and top_watchers so inotify exhaustion can be diagnosed before KDE/Plasma freezes.
jabra JSON exposes USB disconnect counts, topology, PipeWire downstream errors, current processes, and recommendation for speakerphone wedging diagnosis.
audio-switch JSON exposes Jabra USB, Jabra Bluetooth, earbuds Bluetooth, and wired targets so Stream Deck can call deterministic meeting-audio fallback commands.
